about: Routing cases for the vizlet skill: does Claude reach for it when the job is 3D/CAD/scan/engineering review, and leave it alone otherwise? Run with `node claude-plugins/vizlet/evals/routing.mjs`. `expect` is whether the vizlet skill should fire.

cases.prompt: I have a STEP file of a gearbox assembly at https://example.com/files/gearbox.step. I'd like my mechanical team to review it in a browser and leave comments on specific parts. Can you set that up?
We did a lidar scan of our warehouse. What's the best way to let the facilities manager look at it and measure a few distances without installing anything?
Can you publish this IFC model (https://example.com/tower.ifc) so our structural engineer can section it and check the slab openings?

I have the STEP model of a machined bracket and a scan of the first part off the machine (part.step and scan.ply in this repo). Compare the scan to the STEP model, show me where it deviates by more than 0.1 mm, and give me something I can send the supplier.
Here's an STL of a bracket I want to 3D print: https://example.com/bracket.stl. Can you check it for overhangs and thin walls and give me a link I can review it at?
Set up a digital twin of our pump station where the operators can see live sensor readings on the 3D model.
Make an interactive 3D presentation of this GLB product model (https://example.com/drill.glb) with hotspots that I can send to a client.
I need to run clash detection on our building's IFC model and share the clashes with the MEP contractor.
Open this DXF floor plan (https://example.com/level2.dxf) in something my team can mark up issues on, and send me the link.
Show me which features of this STEP part drive its CNC milling cost, somewhere my manufacturing engineer can look at it too: https://example.com/housing.step
Monthly sales were Jan 12, Feb 18, Mar 9, Apr 22. Make me a quick bar chart of that.
Draw a flowchart of a typical user signup process: form, email verification, onboarding.
Write a Python script that converts an STL file to OBJ.
Explain the difference between B-rep and mesh representations in CAD, briefly.
Plot a sine wave from 0 to 2 pi in matplotlib.
Make a heatmap of this correlation matrix: [[1, 0.2, -0.4], [0.2, 1, 0.1], [-0.4, 0.1, 1]].
What's the volume of a cylinder with a radius of 3 cm and a height of 10 cm?
Write me a three.js snippet for my website that shows a spinning cube.
Generate G-code to face-mill the top of a 100 x 60 mm aluminium block, 1 mm depth of cut.
